seed.tagline: Turn a Baserow database into a rulebook you own.
seed.description: Extracts the tables, fields, link-row relationships, formulas and rows of a Baserow database (baserow.io or self-hosted) into a rulebook, then derives everything from it: the Postgres schema, documentation, RuleSpeak, the explainer DAG, an Excel workbook and the browser rulebook editor. Re-pull it with effortless build -id and the rulebook follows the database.
seed.requiresInput: A Baserow database and a database token for it

replacements.label: What should we call it?
replacements.description: Short lower-case project name (becomes the repository and database name)

replacements.label: Baserow URL (put your self-hosted URL here)
replacements.description: Leave as https://api.baserow.io for baserow.io; a self-hosted Baserow goes here instead.

replacements.label: Baserow database id
replacements.description: The numeric database id (in the database URL: /database/<id>/...).

replacements.label: Baserow database token
replacements.description: A database token with read access to that database. Used once for the extraction and not stored.

replacements.label: Which tables hold people?
replacements.description: The tables whose rows are people who sign in (users, staff, customers). Leave blank if none do.
